title: dryopteris arguta
intro: Dryopteris arguta, commonly known as the scaly male fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris arguta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antitumor activities. The plant's extracts have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications, including wound healing, antimicrobial wound treatment, and the inhibition of cancer cell growth.
